zh: 闹钟响了，我还是没起床。
old_en: The alarm went off, but I still didn't get up.
new_en: The alarm went off, but I still didn't get up.

zh: 周末我通常睡到九点才起床。
old_en: On weekends, I usually wake up at nine.
new_en: On weekends, I usually sleep until nine.

zh: 昨晚玩得太晚，今天早上我七点才起来。
old_en: Playing late last night, I didn't get up until seven this morning.
new_en: I played late last night, so I didn't get up until seven this morning.

zh: 爸爸叫我起床，我还是赖在床上不肯动。
old_en: Dad called me, but I refused to get up.
new_en: Dad called me, but I refused to get out of bed.

zh: 妈妈在旁边催促，我这才慢慢起床。
old_en: Mom kept urging me, and I finally got up slowly.
new_en: Mom kept urging me, and I finally got up slowly.

zh: 昨晚熬夜看剧，今天早上起不来。
old_en: I stayed up late watching a show last night, so I couldn't get up this morning.
new_en: I stayed up late watching a show last night, so I couldn't get up this morning.

zh: 昨晚喝了很多酒，早上醒来感觉头很晕。
old_en: I drank a lot of alcohol last night, so I felt dizzy when I woke up this morning.
new_en: I drank a lot of alcohol last night, so I felt dizzy when I woke up this morning.

zh: 虽然定了闹钟，我还是七点才起床。
old_en: Though I had an alarm set, I didn't get up until seven this morning.
new_en: Though I set an alarm, I didn't get up until seven this morning.

zh: 我醒来后第一件事就是看手机。
old_en: The first thing I did after waking up was check my phone.
new_en: The first thing I do after waking up is check my phone.

zh: 昨晚熬夜了，我醒来后头有点痛。
old_en: I stayed up late last night, so I had a headache when I woke up this morning.
new_en: I stayed up late last night, so I had a headache when I woke up.

zh: 起床后我先喝了一杯水。
old_en: After getting up, I had a glass of water first.
new_en: After getting up, I drank a glass of water first.

zh: 我一醒来就喝了一大杯水。
old_en: I woke up early and drank a big glass of water.
new_en: I drank a big glass of water as soon as I woke up.

zh: 冬天早上很难起床，我九点钟才离开被窝。
old_en: It's hard to get up early in winter mornings, so I didn't leave my bed until nine o'clock.
new_en: It's hard to get up early in winter, so I didn't leave my bed until nine.

zh: 昨晚聚会太晚，我十点钟才起床。
old_en: The party lasted late last night, so I didn't get up until ten o'clock.
new_en: The party lasted late, so I didn't get up until ten.

zh: 早起去跑步，我六点就起床了。
old_en: I woke up early to go running, so I got up at six o'clock.
new_en: I woke up at six to go running.

zh: 今天早上天气好，所以我五点就起床去跑步了。
old_en: The weather was nice this morning, so I woke up early to go running at five o'clock.
new_en: The weather was nice, so I got up at five to go running.

zh: 孩子赖床，我每天早上都要叫他起来。
old_en: My child stays in bed, so I have to wake him up every morning.
new_en: My child sleeps in, so I need to wake him up every morning.

zh: 我把闹钟定在六点半，提醒自己按时起床。
old_en: I set the alarm for half past six to wake up on time.
new_en: I set an alarm for six thirty to remind myself to get up on time.

zh: 出差时早起赶车，我五点半就起床了。
old_en: I woke up at half past five to catch the early train on business trips.
new_en: On business trips, I wake up at five thirty to catch the early train.

zh: 昨晚看球赛看到凌晨，早上我还是没起床。
old_en: Although I watched the game until dawn last night, I still didn't get up this morning.
new_en: I stayed up late watching a game last night and still didn't wake up this morning.
